summary: PHYSICAL RECOIL: two 0.30.4-safe mechanisms. (A) a part TriggeredEffects with HitEffects [{Type = Impulse}] - exactly how the vanilla railgun kicks its own ship (VM railgun_launcher.rules:518-556 = V303 :540-578, identical); Impulse is a ModifiableFloat (vanilla scales it with a ScaledBuff), so the Tupã kick can grow with N via BulletStrike_RailShot. (B) the emitter field Recoil (number, one impulse per shot at the emitter, opposite the fire direction): vanilla deck cannon 240, nuke launcher 300, EMP launcher 150; our own guns already ship Recoil up to 400. Recommended: (A) as one kick on the BulletEmitter trigger.

PITFALL in SPEC_2.0 railgun.firing_timeline[4] / visuals.muzzle: 'RecoilProjectile + 1/30 s Timer Impulse 3000' copies the vanilla per-tick push, but our slug crawls through the barrel (SpeedStart 6 -> SpeedEnd 50 tiles/s, 0.25-0.79 s) instead of vanilla 360+ tiles/s (~0.03 s). The timer would fire 8 (N=1) to 24 (N=6) times: 24000-72000 total impulse, 6-18x the vanilla railgun (~2000 x 2 ticks = 4000 at N=4). Also the vanilla RecoilProjectile must have Interpolate = false (game logic on an interpolated component desyncs multiplayer).

SCREEN SHAKE: media effect Type = ScreenShake via the global base /BASE_SHAKE (VM common_effects/base_shake.rules:1-5: DurationFalloff 2, MinDistance 0, MaxDistance 2, DistanceFalloff 1); per use only ShakeAmount + Duration. 0.30.4c fields: ShakeAmount, Duration, DurationFalloff, MinDistance, MaxDistance, DistanceFalloff. Vanilla firing shakes: deck cannon 0.1/1 s (largest gun), large cannon 0.075/0.5, med/chaingun/flak 0.025/0.25; vanilla railgun has NO fire shake (only impact 0.1 x RailgunShot / 0.75 s). Recommended Tupã fire shake 0.2 / 0.7 s in the ponta FireEffect (above our 406 mm 0.12, below reactor_small death 0.25).

SPRITE RECOIL: vanilla deck cannon pattern = a Graphics component with ResetAnimationTrigger = <the shot trigger>, OperationalDoodad AnimationFiles (+NormalsAnimationFiles) whose LAST frame is the rest pose, AnimationStartTime = MinValue, ClampAnimation = true (VM cannon_deck.rules:1173-1272). ResetAnimationTrigger is handled by Graphics, Sprite and SpriteGrid components (AW PartGraphics/PartSprite/PartSpriteGrid.OnResetAnimation) but NOT by ValueSprites/ResourceSprites, so the recoiling drums/rails/crown/breech must move OUT of the static roof and the charge ValueSprites into their own animated Graphics components.

5x5 LOADER CHAIN: criteria Left/Right/Top/Bottom are the TARGET part's edges in this part's unrotated tile coordinates (Right/Bottom exclusive, each optional; VM chaingun.rules:575-635). With canos on loader tiles x 1..3: loader providers/TriggerProxies move to BuffArea [1,-1,3,1] / PartLocation [1,-1] with {Left 1; Right 4; Bottom 0}; loader trilho port to [2,0] Up; every cano component that looks BACK (LoadedAmmo + LoaderBattery proxies, ReverseBuffOperationProvider, cano B ContagemProvider) needs a SECOND criteria entry for the loader {Left -1; Right 4; Top 3} via the list forms ProxyableComponents [...] and Criterias [...] (both vanilla chaingun and live in SW:ACD 0.30.4). The ponta does not change (it only ever touches a cano).

mechanisms.what: Part component TriggeredEffects with HitEffects [ { Type = Impulse; Impulse = <ModifiableFloat> } ]: the hit effect is applied to the part's OWN ship at the component's Location, pushing along the component's world rotation.
vanilla: VM ships/terran/railgun_launcher/railgun_launcher.rules:518-556 (RecoilProjectile : Projectile { Interpolate = false } / RecoilTimer Timer Duration 1/30, AutoStart, Repeats, TriggerWhenStarted, OperationalToggle = ProjectileToggle / RecoilEffects TriggeredEffects ChainedTo = RecoilProjectile, Rotation = 90d, Trigger = RecoilTimer, HitEffects [ Impulse { BaseValue = 2000; Modifiers [ ScaledBuff Overclock Scale RECOIL_FACTOR 250% Multiply ] } ])

VM ships/terran/cannon_deck/cannon_deck.rules:998-1015 (StunEffect: TriggeredEffects with HitEffects on the own ship at Location [2,2], Trigger = MultiTrigger of the emitter proxies - same 'own-ship hit effect on firing' pattern, AreaCrewStun)

fields.TriggeredEffects: Trigger (trigger ID, req), Location [x,y] tiles part-relative (or relative to ChainedTo), Rotation (angle, 'd' suffix), ChainedTo (ID), HitEffects [], MediaEffects [], AnchorMediaEffects bool, HitEffectsFactor / MediaEffectsFactor, MediaEffectsRequireShipInView (AW source-manifest.json:26671 PartTriggeredEffectsRules members: AnchorMediaEffects, HitEffectsFactor, MediaEffectsFactor, MediaEffectsRequireShipInView, Trigger; Location/Rotation from ChainablePartComponentRules)

Impulse hit effect (ImpulseEffectRules,.Impulse: ModifiableFloat - plain number, { BaseValue; BuffType; BuffMode }, or { BaseValue; Modifiers [ ScaledBuff ] } (VM railgun_launcher.rules:540-552); EffectScaleExponent only matters inside shots
Impulse hit effect (ImpulseEffectRules,.ApplyToCenterOfMass: bool (verified VM shots/tractor_beam/tractor_beam_overclock.rules:13); true = no torque, pure translation
Impulse hit effect (ImpulseEffectRules,.PushShip / PushCrew / PushBullet: bool members (0.30.4c), no vanilla use in Impulse; defaults evidently push the ship (vanilla recoil sets none)
Impulse hit effect (ImpulseEffectRules,.UseEffectDirection: bool member; vanilla recoil leaves it unset and steers with Rotation, so the default follows the effect (component) direction

mechanisms.direction: Vanilla: Weapon Rotation = -90d (fires toward -y = 'up' in the unrotated part) and RecoilEffects Rotation = 90d relative to RecoilProjectile (not rotated) = +y = backwards. For the ponta: either no ChainedTo + Rotation = 90d, or ChainedTo = Weapon + Rotation = 180d. Sign: check in game (test T-TR-1); if the ship lurches forward use -90d.
mechanisms.torque: The impulse acts at Location, so an off-centre Tupã also spins the ship (vanilla railgun does the same: its push point runs along the barrel). ApplyToCenterOfMass = true removes the spin. Recommended default: false (vanilla feel), switch rail.recoil_com.
mechanisms.determinism: Game logic (hit effects) must never be ChainedTo a component with Interpolate = true: vanilla comment 'WARNING: Only use this for interpolating graphics. Using it for game logic will cause multiplayer desyncs.' (VM railgun_launcher.rules:501) and the dedicated RecoilProjectile copy with Interpolate = false (:518-521). The TK ponta Projectile has Interpolate = true (TK bs2t_rail_ponta/bs2t_rail_ponta.rules:389): do not chain the kick to it. Trigger = BulletEmitter with no ChainedTo (or ChainedTo = Weapon) is safe.

mechanisms.what: Copy of the vanilla RecoilProjectile/RecoilTimer/RecoilEffects: pushes every 1/30 s while the slug runs.
mechanisms.problem: Our slug is a slow visual run. RailgunProjectile kinematics of the Tupã: SpeedStart 6 -> SpeedEnd 50 tiles/s over 3N+4 tiles, T = (3N+4)/28 s = 0.25/0.36/0.46/0.57/0.68/0.79 s for N=1..6 (SPEC railgun.firing_timeline.per_N; TK bs2t_rail_ponta.rules:21-22,380-390). Timer ticks = 1 + floor(30 T) = 8/11/14/18/21/24. With the SPEC's 3000/tick: 24000/33000/42000/54000/63000/72000 per shot. Vanilla railgun: SpeedStart 360 x RailgunShot (VM shots/bullet_railgun/bullet_railgun.rules:10), N=4 path 16 tiles at ~470 tiles/s = 0.034 s = 2 ticks x 2000 = ~4000 (OC x2.5 ~10000).
mechanisms.if_wanted: Use it only as a small 'push while the slug runs' on top of the kick: per-tick value = desired_total / ticks (e.g. 150/tick = 1200 at N=1 .. 3600 at N=6), always on a RecoilProjectile copy with Interpolate = false.
mechanisms.status: verified mechanism, wrong magnitude in SPEC

mechanisms.what: HitEffects [ { Type = Feedback; HitEffects [ Impulse ] } ] inside a SHOT applies effects back to the firing ship.
mechanisms.evidence: VM shots/tractor_beam/tractor_beam.rules:177-197 (Feedback Impulse = +TractorImpulse/2 to the source), tractor_beam_overclock.rules:16; SW tractor/collector beams; AW FeedbackEffectRules (source-manifest.json:38660)
mechanisms.why_rejected: Fires only when the slug HITS something (late at range, never on a miss). Not a firing jolt.

mechanisms.evidence: VM tractor_beam_emitter.rules:909-952 (Filter Self=false for ships; Self=true only for bullets); AW AreaImpulseEffectRules members ApplyFalloff, Falloff, Filter, Impulse, InvertFalloff, PushShip(s), PushShipCenterOfMassOnly, Radius, UseEffectDirection
mechanisms.why_rejected: Radial push, needs filter tricks to hit the own ship, no vanilla example on the own hull. Option A is the vanilla way.

magnitude_reference.units: Impulse and Recoil share the physics impulse unit (thruster force strings are kN, so impulse ~ kN*s). Thruster forces: huge 8000 (VM thruster_huge/thruster_huge.rules:39), boost 3600/9600 (thruster_boost.rules:56,92).
magnitude_reference.proposal: Kick = { BaseValue = 2400; BuffType = BulletStrike_RailShot; BuffMode = Multiply } (m(N) = 1 + 0.25 N^0.85): N=1 3000, N=2 3380, N=3 3900, N=4 4350, N=5 4750, N=6 5150 = about the vanilla railgun at the same N and well under vanilla OC. Average over the 6 s cycle at N=4 = 725 (9% of one huge thruster): a visible jolt, not a drive. Tune in game (T-TR-1). Fixed-number fallback (mechanism B): Recoil = 4000.

notes: Do NOT combine A with the vanilla RecoilProjectile copy at 3000/tick (SPEC firing_timeline[4]); replace it.
The TK ponta (TK bs2t_rail_ponta.rules) has NO recoil today; TK bs2t_rail_carregador.rules:706-722 FireEffect plays only the vanilla shot sound.
The vanilla railgun loader/accelerators have no sprite recoil and no fire shake: the vanilla railgun's only 'kick' is the physical impulse.

cross_part_trigger.question: Canos and loader do not own the emitter: their reset trigger is a TriggerProxy toward the ponta (cano EmissionTriggered TK bs2t_rail_cano.rules:178-181; loader EmitTrigger TK bs2t_rail_carregador.rules:345-348; vanilla V303 railgun_loader.rules:243-257).
cross_part_trigger.evidence: Vanilla uses those same cross-part TriggerProxies as TriggeredToggle OnTrigger/OffTrigger (V303 railgun_loader.rules:684-690 AmmoHideToggle) and TriggeredEffects Trigger (:838-855). A TriggerProxy implements the part trigger interface (AW wiki/04-integration/logic-gate-authoring.md:130-150 'anything that consumes that signal can point at a proxy'). Vanilla ResetAnimationTrigger only ever points at same-part triggers/proxies.
cross_part_trigger.fallback: Local relay: TrancoRelay { Type = Timer; StartTrigger = EmissionTriggered; Duration = 0.5; TriggerWhenStarted = true } and ResetAnimationTrigger = TrancoRelay (Timer as trigger: VM factory_diamond.rules:272 ConversionTimer; TriggerWhenStarted: VM railgun_launcher.rules:522-530). Or a MultiTrigger { Triggers = [EmissionTriggered] } (ponta EmissionTriggered pattern TK bs2t_rail_ponta.rules:420-424).

Offsets as a fraction of the stroke k: [1.00, 0.85, 0.62, 0.36, 0.12, -0.05, -0.03, 0.00] (small forward overshoot = spring) or without overshoot [1.00, 0.90, 0.74, 0.55, 0.36, 0.19, 0.07, 0.00].

tests.what: Creative, one Tupã N=4 on a small ship at rest, centred: fire once. Ship must move BACKWARD (else flip Rotation to -90d). Note the speed after one shot; compare N=1 and N=6 (buff scaling) and the fixed Recoil = 4000 variant.
Same gun mounted off-centre: ship spins a little; with ApplyToCenterOfMass = true it must not spin.

Every shot replays the crown, every cano's drums and the loader breech frames (cross-part TriggerProxy as ResetAnimationTrigger); at load/build all show the rest frame (AnimationStartTime MinValue). If the canos/loader do not replay: use the local Timer relay.
Shake felt on each shot and gone with Settings > Screen Shake off; no shake when the camera is far (MaxDistance).

5x5 loader chain for N=1..6: CanosOk on, BulletStrike_Rail = N, loader operational (RailReverseOperation reaches it), slug/battery reach the ponta, charge wave lights from the loader port [2,0]. Shift the loader 1 tile left/right: nothing connects (MissingComponent on canos/ponta).
Multiplayer/replay: no desync after many shots (impulse not chained to the Interpolate = true Projectile).
